```{r, Load and Prepare Data}

df <- read.csv("Voter_Reg_STRICT.csv") # Or '3. VR_Simulated_Data.csv' if using simulated data
head(df)

nrow(df) # 12927

zdf <- read.csv("Voter_Reg_STRICT_STANDARDIZED.csv") # Or '4. VR_Simulated_Data_Standard.csv' if using simulated data
head(zdf)

nrow(zdf)

## Prepare variables ##

# Set reference level as the control condition
df$condition <- relevel(as.factor(df$condition), ref = "ControlCondition")

zdf$condition <- relevel(as.factor(zdf$condition), ref = "ControlCondition")

# Make sure link click, register, and vote variables are factors for binary logistic regressions
df$linkClicked <- as.factor(df$linkClicked)
df$register <- as.factor(df$register)
df$vote <- as.factor(df$vote)

# Region
df$region <- relevel(as.factor(df$region), ref = "Northeast") 

```

############################################### Voting Intentions ##############################################
################################################################################################################

# OLS

```{r, Voting Intentions One-Tailed}

# Fit the model 
Intentions_Model_1 <- lm(voteInt ~ condition, data = df)
summary(Intentions_Model_1)

Intentions_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(Intentions_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(Intentions_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
Intentions_Model_1_robust

# HC3 variance-covariance matrix (for JS shrink and emmeans)
vcov_Intentions_Model_1  <- vcovHC(Intentions_Model_1, type = "HC3")

# Standardized
Intentions_Model_1_Stand <- lm(voteInt ~ condition, data = zdf)
summary(Intentions_Model_1_Stand)

# Use one tailed lm function to format (using James-Stein shrinkage)
Intentions_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_output_onetailed_shrink(
  model1 = Intentions_Model_1_robust,
  model2 = Intentions_Model_1_Stand,
  original_model = Intentions_Model_1,
  vcov_matrix = vcov_Intentions_Model_1
)

# Outputs:
Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTeX

# Add Cohen's d

# Means (use same HC3 vcov so that SE, t, and p match)
Intentions_Model_1_means <- emmeans(Intentions_Model_1, ~ condition, 
                                    vcov. = vcov_Intentions_Model_1, df = df.residual(Intentions_Model_1))

# Pairwise contrasts
Intentions_Model_1_pw <- contrast(Intentions_Model_1_means, method = "pairwise", adjust = "none")

# Effect sizes for contrasts (Cohen's d using residual SD)
Intentions_Model_1_d <- as.data.frame(
  eff_size(Intentions_Model_1_means, sigma = sigma(Intentions_Model_1), edf = df.residual(Intentions_Model_1))
)

# Keep only contrasts with control condition
Intentions_Model_1_d_control <- Intentions_Model_1_d %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^ControlCondition - ")) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with appendix output
    Condition = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with full output
    d = clean_round(-effect.size),   # Flip sign so going in proper direction
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!variable_labels) # Apply labels from helper function code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, Condition, d)

Intentions_Model_1_d_control

# Add Cohens d to full output and appendix table output

# Appendix
Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix <- Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix %>%
  left_join(Intentions_Model_1_d_control, by = "Variable") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Condition)

Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix

# Full
Intentions_Model_1_Results$full <- Intentions_Model_1_Results$full %>%
  left_join(Intentions_Model_1_d_control, by = "Condition") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Variable)

Intentions_Model_1_Results$full

# Go to BH section for full Latex output 

# Plot percentages/means within each condition using HC3 robust SEs
Intentions_Model_1_Results_plot <- as.data.frame(
  emmeans(
    Intentions_Model_1,
    ~ condition,
    vcov. = vcov_Intentions_Model_1,
    df = df.residual(Intentions_Model_1),
    level = 0.90
  )
) %>%
  rename(Condition = condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean = emmean,
    Lower_ci = lower.CL,
    Upper_ci = upper.CL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Condition, Mean, Lower_ci, Upper_ci)

rownames(Intentions_Model_1_Results_plot) <- NULL

Intentions_Model_1_Results_plot

# write.csv(Intentions_Model_1_Results_plot, file = "Intentions_Percent.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

# OLS - Joint F

```{r, Intentions Joint F}

# Joint F test voting intentions

linearHypothesis(
  Intentions_Model_1,
  matchCoefs(Intentions_Model_1, "condition"),
  vcov = vcovHC(Intentions_Model_1, type = "HC3"),
  test = "F"
)

```

# Tukey

```{r, Voting Intentions Tukey Adjustment}

##### Adjust p ####

# Escalating Commitment as the reference condition
df$condition_ec <- relevel(factor(df$condition), ref = "EscalatingCommitment")

Intentions_Model_1_EC <- lm(voteInt ~ condition_ec, data = df)
summary(Intentions_Model_1_EC)

Intentions_Model_1_EC_robust <- coeftest(Intentions_Model_1_EC, vcov = vcovHC(Intentions_Model_1_EC, type = "HC3"))
Intentions_Model_1_EC_robust

# HC3 variance-covariance matrix
vcov_Intentions_Model_1_EC  <- vcovHC(Intentions_Model_1_EC, type = "HC3")

# Marginal means (use same HC3 vcov so that SE, t, and p match)
emm_int <- emmeans(Intentions_Model_1_EC, ~ condition_ec, 
                                    vcov. = vcov_Intentions_Model_1_EC, df = df.residual(Intentions_Model_1_EC))

# Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons (two-tailed)
tukey_int <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm_int, adjust = "Tukey")))

# Keep relevant comparisons 
ec_int <- tukey_int %>%
  filter(grepl("EscalatingCommitment", contrast))

# Apply formatting and sorting
ec_int_clean <- ec_int %>%
  mutate(
    Contrast = contrast,
    Estimate = sprintf("%.2f", estimate),
    SE = sprintf("%.2f", SE),
    t = sprintf("%.2f", t.ratio),
    p = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)))) %>%
    dplyr::select(Contrast, Estimate, SE, t, p) %>%
    filter(!Contrast == 'EscalatingCommitment - ControlCondition') # Control condition not needed

ec_int_clean

# For latex
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r")

ec_int_clean_appendix_xtable <- xtable(ec_int_clean, align = align_spec, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

print.xtable(ec_int_clean_appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

```

# By Region

```{r, Voting Intentions Interaction with Region Two-Tailed}

# Interaction with region
Intentions_Model_16 <- lm(voteInt ~ condition * region, data = df)
summary(Intentions_Model_16)

# HC3 robust variance-covariance matrix
vcov_Intentions_Model_16 <- vcovHC(Intentions_Model_16, type = "HC3")

# Optional: robust coefficient table
Intentions_Model_16_robust <- coeftest(
  Intentions_Model_16,
  vcov = vcov_Intentions_Model_16
)
Intentions_Model_16_robust

# Means within each region using HC3 robust SEs
intmeansregion <- emmeans(
  Intentions_Model_16,
  ~ condition | region,
  vcov. = vcov_Intentions_Model_16,
  df = df.residual(Intentions_Model_16),
  level = 0.95
)

# Condition differences by region using HC3 robust SEs
intcomparecond <- as.data.frame(
  pairs(intmeansregion, adjust = "None", by = "region")
) %>%
  filter(grepl("ControlCondition", contrast)) # Only keep comparisons with control

intcomparecond

# Apply formatting and sorting
intcomparecond_clean <- intcomparecond %>%
  mutate(
    Contrast = contrast,
    b = sprintf("%.2f", -1 * estimate),
    SE = sprintf("%.2f", SE),
    t = sprintf("%.2f", -1 * t.ratio),
    p = ifelse(
      p.value < 0.001,
      "<.001",
      sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Contrast, b, SE, t, p)

intcomparecond_clean

# For LaTeX
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r")

intcomparecond_clean_clean_appendix_xtable <- xtable(
  intcomparecond_clean,
  align = align_spec,
  include.rownames = FALSE,
  sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
  sanitize.text.function = identity,
  floating = FALSE
)

print.xtable(intcomparecond_clean_clean_appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE)

```

# OLS

```{r, Link Click One-Tailed}

# Fit the model (use OLS)
Link_Model_1 <- lm(linkClicked_n ~ condition, data = df) 
summary(Link_Model_1)

Link_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(Link_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(Link_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
Link_Model_1_robust

# HC3 variance-covariance matrix (for JS shrink and emmeans)
vcov_Link_Model_1  <- vcovHC(Link_Model_1, type = "HC3")

# Standardized
Link_Model_1_Stand <- lm(linkClicked_n ~ condition, data = zdf) 
summary(Link_Model_1_Stand)

# Use one tailed lm function to format (using James-Stein shrinkage)
Link_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_bin_output_onetailed_shrink(
  Link_Model_1_robust,
  Link_Model_1_Stand,
  original_model = Link_Model_1,
  vcov_matrix = vcov_Link_Model_1)

# Outputs:
Link_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTeX

# Add Cohen's d

# Means (use same HC3 vcov so that SE, t, and p match)
Link_Model_1_means <- emmeans(Link_Model_1, ~ condition, 
                                    vcov. = vcov_Link_Model_1, df = df.residual(Link_Model_1))

# Pairwise contrasts
Link_Model_1_pw <- contrast(Link_Model_1_means, method = "pairwise", adjust = "none")

# Effect sizes for contrasts (Cohen's d using residual SD)
Link_Model_1_d <- as.data.frame(
  eff_size(Link_Model_1_means, sigma = sigma(Link_Model_1), edf = df.residual(Link_Model_1))
)

# Keep only contrasts with control condition
Link_Model_1_d_control <- Link_Model_1_d %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^ControlCondition - ")) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with appendix output
    Condition = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with full output
    d = clean_round(-effect.size),   # Flip sign so going in proper direction
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!variable_labels) # Apply labels from helper function code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, Condition, d)

Link_Model_1_d_control

# Add Cohens d to full output and appendix table output

# Appendix
Link_Model_1_Results$appendix <- Link_Model_1_Results$appendix %>%
  left_join(Link_Model_1_d_control, by = "Variable") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Condition)

Link_Model_1_Results$appendix

# Full
Link_Model_1_Results$full <- Link_Model_1_Results$full %>%
  left_join(Link_Model_1_d_control, by = "Condition") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Variable)

Link_Model_1_Results$full

# Go to BH section for full Latex output 

# Plot percentages within each condition using HC3 robust SEs
Link_Model_1_Results_plot <- as.data.frame(
  emmeans(
    Link_Model_1,
    ~ condition,
    vcov. = vcov_Link_Model_1,
    df = df.residual(Link_Model_1),
    level = 0.90
  )
) %>%
  rename(Condition = condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean = emmean * 100,
    Lower_ci = lower.CL * 100,
    Upper_ci = upper.CL * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Condition, Mean, Lower_ci, Upper_ci)

rownames(Link_Model_1_Results_plot) <- NULL

Link_Model_1_Results_plot
```

# Tukey

```{r, Link Click Tukey Adjustment}

##### Adjust p ####

# Escalating Commitment as the reference condition
df$condition_ec <- relevel(factor(df$condition), ref = "EscalatingCommitment")

# Fit the model (use OLS)
Link_Model_1_EC <- lm(linkClicked_n ~ condition_ec, data = df) 
summary(Link_Model_1_EC)

Link_Model_1_EC_robust <- coeftest(Link_Model_1_EC, vcov = vcovHC(Link_Model_1_EC, type = "HC3"))
Link_Model_1_EC_robust

# HC3 variance-covariance matrix
vcov_Link_Model_1_EC  <- vcovHC(Link_Model_1_EC, type = "HC3")

# Marginal means (use same HC3 vcov so that SE, t, and p match)
emm_link <- emmeans(Link_Model_1_EC, ~ condition_ec, 
                                    vcov. = vcov_Link_Model_1_EC, df = df.residual(Link_Model_1_EC))

# Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons
tukey_link <- as.data.frame(summary(pairs(emm_link, adjust = "Tukey")))

# Keep relevant comparisons
ec_link <- tukey_link %>%
  filter(grepl("EscalatingCommitment", contrast))

ec_link_clean <- ec_link %>% 
  mutate(
    Contrast = contrast,
    'PP Inc.' = sprintf("%.2f", 100*estimate),
    b = clean_round(estimate),
    SE = sprintf("%.2f", SE),
    t = sprintf("%.2f", t.ratio),
    p = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Contrast, 'PP Inc.', b, SE, t, p) %>%
  filter(!Contrast == 'EscalatingCommitment - ControlCondition') # Control condition not needed

ec_link_clean

# For latex
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")

ec_link_clean_xtable <- xtable(ec_link_clean, align = align_spec, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

print.xtable(ec_link_clean_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

```

# Firth's Penalized Regression

```{r, Link Click Firth's Robustness Check One-Tailed}

# Firth’s penalized logistic regression reduces bias in logistic regression with imbalanced data (i.e., more 0s than 1s)
Link_Model_3 <- logistf(data=df, linkClicked~condition,  alpha = 0.10)
summary(Link_Model_3)

# Calculate proper one-tailed p value
coefs <-Link_Model_3$coefficients
p_two <- Link_Model_3$prob
  
p_one <- ifelse(coefs > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - (p_two / 2)) # If pos, divide p by 2, if neg (opposite of proposed direction) 1-(p/2)
p_one["(Intercept)"] <- p_two["(Intercept)"]

# Extract standard errors and confidence intervals
se <- sqrt(diag(Link_Model_3$var))

# CI 
conf_int <- confint(Link_Model_3)
conf_int

# Create a data frame 
Link_Model_3_Results <- data.frame(
  Variable = gsub("condition", "", names(coefs)),
  Log_Odds = coefs,
  OR = exp(coefs),
  SE_LO = se,
  p = p_one,
  Lower_ci_LO = conf_int[, 1],
  Upper_ci_LO = conf_int[, 2],
  Lower_ci = exp(conf_int[, 1]),
  Upper_ci = exp(conf_int[, 2])
)

rownames(Link_Model_3_Results) <- NULL

# Clean up
Link_Model_3_Results <- Link_Model_3_Results %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!variable_labels), # Edit variable names
    Log_Odds = sprintf("%.2f", Log_Odds), # Round 
    OR = sprintf("%.2f", OR), 
    SE_LO = sprintf("%.2f", SE_LO),
    p = ifelse(p < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p))), 
    Lower_ci_LO = sprintf("%.2f", Lower_ci_LO), # CI in brackets
    Upper_ci_LO = sprintf("%.2f", Upper_ci_LO),
    Lower_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Lower_ci), 
    Upper_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Upper_ci),
    `90% CI` = paste0("[", Lower_ci, ", ", Upper_ci, "]")
        
) %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable,
         OR, p, `90% CI`)

Link_Model_3_Results

# For latex
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r")

Link_Model_3_Results_appendix_xtable <- xtable(Link_Model_3_Results, align = align_spec, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

print.xtable(Link_Model_3_Results_appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor
# When report, p-value for intercept is from 2-tailed model

```

```{r, Link Clicks Interaction with Region Two-Tailed}
  Link_Model_25,
  ~ condition | region,
  vcov. = vcov_Link_Model_25,
  df = df.residual(Link_Model_25),
  level = 0.95
)

# Condition differences by region using HC3 robust SEs
linkcomparecond <- as.data.frame(
  pairs(linkmeansregion, adjust = "None", by = "region")
) %>%
  filter(grepl("ControlCondition", contrast))

linkcomparecond

# Apply formatting and sorting
linkcomparecond_clean <- linkcomparecond %>%
  mutate(
    Contrast = contrast,
    'PP Inc.' = clean_round((-100) * estimate), # Flip direction, flip intervention names in LaTeX
    b = clean_round((-1) * estimate),
    SE = clean_round(SE),
    t = clean_round((-1) * t.ratio),
    p = ifelse(
      p.value < 0.001,
      "<.001",
      sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Contrast, 'PP Inc.', b, SE, t, p)

linkcomparecond_clean

# For latex
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")

linkcomparecond_clean_appendix_xtable <- xtable(linkcomparecond_clean, align = align_spec, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

print.xtable(linkcomparecond_clean_appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

```

# OLS

```{r, Registration One-Tailed (OLS)}

# Fit the model 
Registration_Model_1 <- lm(register_n ~ condition, data = df) 
summary(Registration_Model_1)

Registration_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(Registration_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(Registration_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
Registration_Model_1_robust

# HC3 variance-covariance matrix
vcov_Registration_Model_1  <- vcovHC(Registration_Model_1, type = "HC3")

# Standardized
Registration_Model_1_Stand <- lm(register_n ~ condition, data = zdf) 
summary(Registration_Model_1_Stand)

# Use one tailed lm function to format (using James-Stein shrinkage)
Registration_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_bin_output_onetailed_shrink(
  Registration_Model_1_robust,
  Registration_Model_1_Stand,
  original_model = Registration_Model_1,
  vcov_matrix = vcov_Registration_Model_1)

# Outputs:
Registration_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTex

# Add Cohen's d

# Means (use same HC3 vcov so that SE, t, and p match)
Registration_Model_1_means <- emmeans(Registration_Model_1, ~ condition, 
                                    vcov. = vcov_Registration_Model_1, df = df.residual(Registration_Model_1))

# Pairwise contrasts
Registration_Model_1_pw <- contrast(Registration_Model_1_means, method = "pairwise", adjust = "none")

# Effect sizes for contrasts (Cohen's d using residual SD)
Registration_Model_1_d <- as.data.frame(
  eff_size(Registration_Model_1_means, sigma = sigma(Registration_Model_1), edf = df.residual(Registration_Model_1))
)

# Keep only contrasts with control condition
Registration_Model_1_d_control <- Registration_Model_1_d %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^ControlCondition - ")) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with appendix output
    Condition = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with full output
    d = clean_round(-effect.size),   # Flip sign so going in proper direction
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!variable_labels) # Apply labels from helper function code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, Condition, d)

Registration_Model_1_d_control

# Add Cohens d to full output and appendix table output

# Appendix
Registration_Model_1_Results$appendix <- Registration_Model_1_Results$appendix %>%
  left_join(Registration_Model_1_d_control, by = "Variable") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Condition)

Registration_Model_1_Results$appendix

# Full
Registration_Model_1_Results$full <- Registration_Model_1_Results$full %>%
  left_join(Registration_Model_1_d_control, by = "Condition") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Variable)

Registration_Model_1_Results$full

# Go to BH section for Latex

# Plot percentages within each condition using HC3 robust SEs
Registration_Model_1_Results_plot <- as.data.frame(
  emmeans(
    Registration_Model_1,
    ~ condition,
    vcov. = vcov_Registration_Model_1,
    df = df.residual(Registration_Model_1),
    level = 0.90
  )
) %>%
  rename(Condition = condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean = emmean * 100,
    Lower_ci = lower.CL * 100,
    Upper_ci = upper.CL * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Condition, Mean, Lower_ci, Upper_ci)

rownames(Registration_Model_1_Results_plot) <- NULL

Registration_Model_1_Results_plot

# Export the table as a data set 

# write.csv(Registration_Model_1_Results_plot, file = "Register_Percent.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Bayes

```{r, Registration, Bayes}

df_bayes_reg <- na.omit(df[, c("register_n", "condition")])
# H0 - no condition differences
# H1 - condition differences 

# Primary analysis: default prior (r = 1/2 = .5)
bf_medium_reg <- anovaBF(register_n ~ condition, data = df_bayes_reg, iterations = 10000, rscaleFixed = "medium")
bf_medium_reg  
# H10 = 2.50e-09 ±0.04%

# Sensitivity analysis: wider prior (sqrt(2)/2 = 0.71)
bf_wide_reg <- anovaBF(register_n ~ condition, data = df_bayes_reg, iterations = 10000, rscaleFixed = "wide")
bf_wide_reg
# H10 = 8.81e-11 ±0.09%

# Sensitivity analysis: narrower prior (1-sqrt(2)/2 = 0.29)
bf_narrow_reg <- anovaBF(register_n ~ condition, data = df_bayes_reg, iterations = 10000, rscaleFixed = (1 - sqrt(2)/2))
bf_narrow_reg
# H10 = 3.44e-07 ±0.47%

```

# Firth's Penalized Regression

```{r, Registration Firth's Robustness Check One-Tailed}

# Firth’s penalized logistic regression
Registration_Model_4 <- logistf(data=df, register~condition, alpha = 0.10)
summary(Registration_Model_4)

# Calculate proper one-tailed p value
coefs <-Registration_Model_4$coefficients
p_two <- Registration_Model_4$prob
  
p_one <- ifelse(coefs > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - (p_two / 2)) # If pos, divide p by 2, if neg (opposite of proposed direction) 1-(p/2)
p_one["(Intercept)"] <- p_two["(Intercept)"]

# Extract standard errors and confidence intervals
se <- sqrt(diag(Registration_Model_4$var))

# CI 
conf_int <- confint(Registration_Model_4)
conf_int

# Create a data frame
Registration_Model_4_Results <- data.frame(
  Variable = gsub("condition", "", names(coefs)),
  Log_Odds = coefs,
  OR = exp(coefs),
  SE_LO = se,
  p = p_one,
  Lower_ci_LO = conf_int[, 1],
  Upper_ci_LO = conf_int[, 2],
  Lower_ci = exp(conf_int[, 1]),
  Upper_ci = exp(conf_int[, 2])
)

rownames(Registration_Model_4_Results) <- NULL

# Clean up
Registration_Model_4_Results <- Registration_Model_4_Results %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!variable_labels), # Edit variable names
    Log_Odds = sprintf("%.2f", Log_Odds), # Round 
    OR = sprintf("%.2f", OR), 
    SE_LO = sprintf("%.2f", SE_LO),
    p = ifelse(p < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p))), 
    Lower_ci_LO = sprintf("%.2f", Lower_ci_LO), # CI in brackets
    Upper_ci_LO = sprintf("%.2f", Upper_ci_LO),
    Lower_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Lower_ci), 
    Upper_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Upper_ci),
    `90% CI` = paste0("[", Lower_ci, ", ", Upper_ci, "]")
        
) %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable,
         OR, p, `90% CI`)

Registration_Model_4_Results

# For latex
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r")

Registration_Model_4_Results_appendix_xtable <- xtable(Registration_Model_4_Results, align = align_spec, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

print.xtable(Registration_Model_4_Results_appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor
# Make sure p-value for intercept is from 2-tailed model

```

```{r, Registration Interaction with Region Two-Tailed}
# Interaction with region

summary(Registration_Model_20)

# Means within each region using HC3 robust SEs
regmeansregion <- emmeans(
  Registration_Model_20,
  ~ condition | region,
  vcov. = vcov_Registration_Model_20,
  df = df.residual(Registration_Model_20),
  level = 0.95
)

# Condition differences by region using HC3 robust SEs

  pairs(regmeansregion, adjust = "None", by = "region")
) %>%
  filter(grepl("ControlCondition", contrast)) # Only keep comparisons with control

regcomparecond

# Apply formatting
regcomparecond_clean <- regcomparecond %>%
  mutate(
    Contrast = contrast,
    'PP Inc.' = clean_round((-100) * estimate), # Flip direction, flip intervention names in LaTeX
    b = clean_round((-1) * estimate),
    SE = clean_round(SE),
    t = clean_round((-1) * t.ratio),
    p = ifelse(
      p.value < 0.001,
      "<.001",
      sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Contrast, 'PP Inc.', b, SE, t, p)

regcomparecond_clean

# For LaTeX
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")

regcomparecond_clean_appendix_xtable <- xtable(

  sanitize.text.function = identity,
  floating = FALSE
)
```

# OLS 
                            
```{r, Voting One-Tailed OLS}

# Fit the model 
Vote_Model_1 <- lm(vote_n ~ condition, data = df) 
summary(Vote_Model_1)

Vote_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(Vote_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(Vote_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
Vote_Model_1_robust

Vote_Model_1_Stand <- lm(vote_n ~ condition, data = zdf) 
summary(Vote_Model_1_Stand)

# Use one tailed lm function to format
Vote_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_bin_output_onetailed(Vote_Model_1_robust, Vote_Model_1_Stand)

# Outputs:
Vote_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTeX

# Add Cohen's d

# HC3 variance-covariance matrix
vcov_Vote_Model_1  <- vcovHC(Vote_Model_1, type = "HC3")

# Means (use same HC3 vcov so that SE, t, and p match)
Vote_Model_1_means <- emmeans(Vote_Model_1, ~ condition, 
                                    vcov. = vcov_Vote_Model_1, df = df.residual(Vote_Model_1))

# Pairwise contrasts
Vote_Model_1_pw <- contrast(Vote_Model_1_means, method = "pairwise", adjust = "none")

# Effect sizes for contrasts (Cohen's d using residual SD)
Vote_Model_1_d <- as.data.frame(
  eff_size(Vote_Model_1_means, sigma = sigma(Vote_Model_1), edf = df.residual(Vote_Model_1))
)

# Keep only contrasts with control condition
Vote_Model_1_d_control <- Vote_Model_1_d %>%
  filter(str_detect(contrast, "^ControlCondition - ")) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with appendix output
    Condition = str_remove(contrast, "^ControlCondition - "), # To merge with full output
    d = clean_round(-effect.size),   # Flip sign so going in proper direction
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!variable_labels) # Apply labels from helper function code
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, Condition, d)

Vote_Model_1_d_control

# Add Cohens d to full output and appendix table output

# Appendix
Vote_Model_1_Results$appendix <- Vote_Model_1_Results$appendix %>%
  left_join(Vote_Model_1_d_control, by = "Variable") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Condition)

Vote_Model_1_Results$appendix

# Full
Vote_Model_1_Results$full <- Vote_Model_1_Results$full %>%
  left_join(Vote_Model_1_d_control, by = "Condition") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Variable)

Vote_Model_1_Results$full

# Latex table
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")

Vote_Model_1_Results_xtable <- xtable(Vote_Model_1_Results$appendix, align = align_spec, booktabs = T)
  
# Print appendix
print.xtable(Vote_Model_1_Results_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

# Plot percentages within each condition using HC3 robust SEs
Vote_Model_1_Results_plot <- as.data.frame(
  emmeans(
    Vote_Model_1,
    ~ condition,
    vcov. = vcov_Vote_Model_1,
    df = df.residual(Vote_Model_1),
    level = 0.90
  )
) %>%
  rename(Condition = condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Mean = emmean * 100,
    Lower_ci = lower.CL * 100,
    Upper_ci = upper.CL * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Condition, Mean, Lower_ci, Upper_ci)

rownames(Vote_Model_1_Results_plot) <- NULL

Vote_Model_1_Results_plot

# write.csv(Vote_Model_1_Results_plot, file = "Vote_Percent.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Bayes

```{r, Voting, Bayes}

df_bayes_vote <- na.omit(df[, c("vote_n", "condition")])
# H0 - no condition differences
# H1 - condition differences 

# Primary analysis: default prior (r = 1/2 = .5)
bf_anova_vote <- anovaBF(vote_n ~ condition, data = df_bayes_vote, iterations = 10000, rscaleFixed = "medium")
bf_anova_vote 
# H10 = 2.04e-08 ±0.02%

# Sensitivity analysis: wider prior (sqrt(2)/2 = 0.71)
bf_wide_vote <- anovaBF(vote_n ~ condition, data = df_bayes_vote, iterations = 10000, rscaleFixed = "wide")
bf_wide_vote
# H10 = 7.46e-10 ±0.07%

# Sensitivity analysis: narrower prior (1-sqrt(2)/2 = 0.29)
bf_narrow_vote <- anovaBF(vote_n ~ condition, data = df_bayes_vote, iterations = 10000, rscaleFixed = (1 - sqrt(2)/2))
bf_narrow_vote
# H10 = 2.52e-06 ±0.14%

```

# Firth's Penalized Regression

```{r, Voting Firth's Robustness Check One-Tailed}

# Firth’s penalized logistic regression reduces bias in logistic regression with imbalanced data (i.e., more 0s than 1s)
Vote_Model_3 <- logistf(data=df, vote~condition, alpha = 0.10)
summary(Vote_Model_3)

# Calculate proper one-tailed p value
coefs <-Vote_Model_3$coefficients
p_two <- Vote_Model_3$prob
  
p_one <- ifelse(coefs > 0, p_two / 2, 1 - (p_two / 2)) # If pos, divide p by 2, if neg (opposite of proposed direction) 1-(p/2)
p_one["(Intercept)"] <- p_two["(Intercept)"]

# Extract standard errors and confidence intervals
se <- sqrt(diag(Vote_Model_3$var))

# CI 
conf_int <- confint(Vote_Model_3)
conf_int

# Create a data frame
Vote_Model_3_Results <- data.frame(
  Variable = gsub("condition", "", names(coefs)),
  Log_Odds = coefs,
  OR = exp(coefs),
  SE_LO = se,
  p = p_one,
  Lower_ci_LO = conf_int[, 1],
  Upper_ci_LO = conf_int[, 2],
  Lower_ci = exp(conf_int[, 1]),
  Upper_ci = exp(conf_int[, 2])
)

rownames(Vote_Model_3_Results) <- NULL

Vote_Model_3_Results

# Clean up
Vote_Model_3_Results <- Vote_Model_3_Results %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!variable_labels), # Edit variable names
    Log_Odds = sprintf("%.2f", Log_Odds), # Round 
    OR = sprintf("%.2f", OR), 
    SE_LO = sprintf("%.2f", SE_LO),
    p = ifelse(p < 0.001, "<.001", sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p))), 
    Lower_ci_LO = sprintf("%.2f", Lower_ci_LO), # CI in brackets
    Upper_ci_LO = sprintf("%.2f", Upper_ci_LO),
    Lower_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Lower_ci), 
    Upper_ci = sprintf("%.2f", Upper_ci),
    `90% CI` = paste0("[", Lower_ci, ", ", Upper_ci, "]")
        
) %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable,
         OR, p, `90% CI`)

# For latex
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r")

Vote_Model_3_Results_appendix_xtable <- xtable(Vote_Model_3_Results, align = align_spec, include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.colnames.function = identity, sanitize.text.function = identity, floating = FALSE)

print.xtable(Vote_Model_3_Results_appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor
# Make sure p-value for intercept is from 2-tailed model

```

# By Region

```{r, Voting Interaction with Region Two-Tailed}

# Interaction with region
Vote_Model_18 <- lm(vote_n ~ condition * region, data = df)
summary(Vote_Model_18)

# HC3 robust variance-covariance matrix
vcov_Vote_Model_18 <- vcovHC(Vote_Model_18, type = "HC3")

# Means within each region using HC3 robust SEs
votemeansregion <- emmeans(
  Vote_Model_18,
  ~ condition | region,
  vcov. = vcov_Vote_Model_18,
  df = df.residual(Vote_Model_18),
  level = 0.95
) 
# Warning occurs because both Moral Reasons and Self-Generated Norms have 0 turnout in the South
# Proceed because this comparison is not reported; all reported treatment-vs-control contrasts have valid SEs

# Condition differences by region using HC3 robust SEs
votecomparecond <- as.data.frame(
  pairs(votemeansregion, adjust = "None", by = "region")
) %>%
  filter(grepl("ControlCondition", contrast)) # Only keep comparisons with control

votecomparecond

# Apply formatting
votecomparecond_clean <- votecomparecond %>%
  mutate(
    Contrast = contrast,
    'PP Inc.' = clean_round((-100) * estimate), # Flip direction, flip intervention names in LaTeX
    b = clean_round((-1) * estimate),
    SE = clean_round(SE),
    t = clean_round((-1) * t.ratio),
    p = ifelse(
      p.value < 0.001,
      "<.001",
      sub("^0\\.", ".", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Contrast, 'PP Inc.', b, SE, t, p)

votecomparecond_clean

# For LaTeX
align_spec <- c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")

votecomparecond_clean_appendix_xtable <- xtable(
  votecomparecond_clean,
  align = align_spec,
  include.rownames = FALSE,
  sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
  sanitize.text.function = identity,
  floating = FALSE
)

print.xtable(votecomparecond_clean_appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE)

```

################################################################################################################
####################################### Associations between Primary DVs #######################################
################################################################################################################

```{r, Correlations Between DVs}

# Just in the control condition
df_control_sub <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(condition == "ControlCondition") # control condition only

# Association between link clicks and registration
cor.test(df_control_sub$linkClicked_n, df_control_sub$register_n) # r = 0.09, p-value = .002

# Association between voting intentions and voting 
cor.test(df$voteInt, df$vote_n) # r = 0.11, p-value < 2.2e-16

##

# Proportion of people who voted of those registered, in the whole sample
df %>% 
  filter(register_n == 1) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(vote_n = mean(vote_n, na.rm = TRUE))  # Proportion who voted

# 0.37
# Among participants who we registered, 37% reported voting. 

```
